verdict.line: You lose extended trades where Mordekaiser lands three hits for Darkness Rise before you can answer; you win short all-ins where Counter Strike (E) denies his autos and lands the stun first.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's passive Darkness Rise only triggers after he lands 3 attacks or spells on you, and Jax's E (Counter Strike) dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration before stunning and damaging surrounding enemies on expiry - so this lane is decided by whether Jax's E window lines up with Mordekaiser's attack-stacking windup. Over 2,497 games this sits at 50.8% for Jax, which matches the OP.GG even/even read: neither champion has a structural kill threat, it's a timing duel.

theirWindow.what: He gains a damage aura and bonus move speed the instant it procs - disengage immediately rather than trying to out-trade it, since the move speed means Q (Leap Strike) won't cleanly create distance. Reset to minions or your turret and let the buff fall off before re-engaging.

yourWindow.when: E (Counter Strike) is off cooldown and he's in auto range
yourWindow.what: Walk up and bait an auto - the dodge window means his attack doesn't land toward Darkness Rise and you get a free stun plus damage on expiry. This is Jax's cleanest way to start an all-in without eating the first exchange.

start.why: Highest sample and pick rate (51.4% over 1,897 games, 60.9% pick) - the extra AD and sustain matter because you're going to be trading autos into a melee opponent whose Q rewards single-target hits.

boots.why: 50.2% over 1,848 games and the dominant pick (64.8%) - Mordekaiser's damage is entirely magic, so the magic resist directly undercuts Obliterate and Death's Grasp.

core.why: Highest-winrate core path starts here (55.8% over 233 games) - the attack speed and burst proc scale directly with Relentless Assault's (R) every-third-hit bonus.
Second item in the top-performing path; its on-hit proc stacks with the same attack-speed-driven trade pattern you're already running.
Closes out the 55.8% winrate path and gives you a way to survive a bad Death's Grasp pull into his Q without dying before you can disengage.

situational.when: he's building toward tank stats or leaning on Indestructible's shield to stall fights, since % current health physical damage cuts through that sustain
the lane drags into repeated extended trades and you need more magic resist alongside the attack speed you're already stacking

runes.keystoneWhy: This page measures higher (50.5% over its sample) despite lower play rate, and it fits the structural read here: Mordekaiser's early Q poke rewards sustain through chip damage rather than racing to burst him down before you have items.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-run (77.5% pick) and winning (50.4%) combo in this matchup - Ignite punishes the all-in windows you create with Counter Strike. Teleport (46.5%, 13.5% pick) is the alternative if you're planning to win the lane through scaling and side-lane pressure instead of early kills.

playing.title: Deny his passive with E timing
playing.detail: Save Counter Strike (E) for the moment he's about to land his 3rd attack or spell, not as a reactive panic button - dodging that hit resets his Darkness Rise progress entirely.

playing.title: Retreat on passive proc, no exceptions
playing.detail: Once Darkness Rise activates, his damage aura and move speed win the continued trade and let him stick to you - disengage to a wave or your tower rather than trying to fight through it.

playing.title: Respect the 700-range pull
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (E) doesn't stun but it does pull every enemy in its area, which sets up his full Q-auto combo. Don't sit at low HP inside that range even if you think you can walk away after.

playing.title: Full combo trades only with E ready
playing.detail: Q (Leap Strike) into W (Empower) burst is fine for poke, but don't commit to a full all-in unless Counter Strike is off cooldown to answer his retaliation.

playing.title: Punish after he consumes Indestructible
playing.detail: Once he pops his W (Indestructible) shield to heal, he has no damage mitigation up for its 8-12s cooldown - that's your window to force the next trade.

playing.title: Play for the Trinity Force timing
playing.detail: This matchup swings in your favor once your attack speed scaling comes online around levels 7-11 - play patient short trades before then and start forcing extended duels after.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical and timing analysis is my own reading of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being pulled by Death’s Grasp(E). Retreat if Mordekaiser’s passive ability activates.
